title: Splunk HEC documentation page renders all sections and banners
verifies: the Splunk HEC documentation page renders its six sections and two warning banners, and the endpoint copy block is root-mounted and org-free

title: Splunk HEC page links to the org-scoped Ingestion Tokens page
verifies: the auth-section link routes to /web/iam/ingestionTokens with the org query param and the tokens page title renders

title: End-to-end HEC ingestion via collector returns code 0 and health returns code 17
verifies: a freshly minted Splunk GUID ingests via POST /services/collector (code 0) and the unauthenticated health check returns code 17

title: Create token with Splunk HEC token via UI reveals GUID and HEC URL
verifies: the create dialog's Splunk checkbox mints a lowercase GUID and HEC URL surfaced in the revealed dialog

title: Generate a Splunk GUID for an existing token via the per-row action
verifies: the per-row generate action mints a GUID on a token created without one, changing the Splunk cell from "Not enabled" to a GUID

title: Revoking a Splunk GUID makes the collector reject it with 403
verifies: after revoking the GUID, POST /services/collector returns 403 with code 1 or 4

title: Disabled backing token rejects the collector with 403 code 1
verifies: after disabling the backing token, POST /services/collector returns 403 code 1

title: Copy snippets write to clipboard and show a toast
verifies: the example copy button writes the curl snippet to the clipboard and fires the copied success toast
